jobs.title: GA DOR - Applications Developer 1
jobs.description:
Varmoda is seeking an **Application Developer** to support the configuration, enhancement, development, and ongoing administration of a mission-critical Commercial Off-The-Shelf (COTS) application platform supporting multiple integrated modules and business functions. This role will work across requirements gathering, application configuration, development, testing, deployment, debugging, and production support activities.

The ideal candidate is a technically strong developer with experience in object-oriented programming, SQL databases, application configuration, and software development best practices. Candidates should be eager to learn, adaptable, and capable of working in both Agile and traditional development environments.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Support configuration and administration of a multi-module Commercial Off-The-Shelf (COTS) application platform.
* Gather, analyze, and document business and technical requirements.
* Configure application settings, reference tables, business rules, and user access permissions.
* Develop and implement application enhancements and change requests.
* Perform scripting, software debugging, troubleshooting, and root-cause analysis.
* Support source control management and deployment activities.
* Conduct application testing, validation, and quality assurance activities.
* Develop implementation specifications and technical documentation.
* Provide production application support and issue resolution.
* Collaborate with business stakeholders, technical teams, and project personnel to deliver system enhancements.
* Ensure software solutions follow development standards, coding best practices, and established methodologies.
* Participate in system upgrades, integrations, and release activities.

**Required Qualifications**

* Bachelor's Degree required (Computer Science, Computer Information Systems, Management Information Systems, Mathematics, or related discipline preferred).
* Minimum 2 years of hands-on experience working with SQL databases.
* Minimum 2 years of object-oriented software development experience utilizing:
  + C#
  + .NET
  + Java
  + VB.NET
  + Similar OO programming languages
* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
* Strong verbal and written communication skills.
* Proficiency with Microsoft Office Suite:
  + Word
  + Excel
  + Outlook
  + PowerPoint
* Knowledge of software development methodologies and SDLC concepts.
* Understanding of coding standards, development best practices, and application support processes.
* Ability to troubleshoot and resolve application issues.
* Strong willingness to learn new technologies and business processes.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience with web services development and integrations.
* Familiarity with REST APIs and API integrations.
* Experience working with AWS cloud services.
* Experience developing and optimizing SQL Stored Procedures.
* Experience supporting enterprise COTS software solutions.
* Exposure to Agile development environments.
* Experience with software configuration and customization activities.
* Familiarity with source control and application deployment processes.

**Certifications & Clearance**

**Required Compliance**

* U.S. Citizen or Green Card Holder required.
* Local Georgia candidates only.
* Tax Clearance Letter required at the time of submission.
* Candidate must successfully pass:
  + Criminal Background Investigation
  + Fingerprinting Process
  + Georgia Tax Compliance Verification

**Important Eligibility Requirements**

* Candidates with overdue or unpaid Georgia tax obligations are not eligible.
* Candidates with felony convictions are not eligible.
* No OPT, CPT, or Employment Authorization Document (EAD) candidates will be considered.

**Preferred Certifications**

* AWS Cloud Practitioner
* Microsoft Azure Fundamentals
* Oracle SQL Certification
* Java or .NET Development Certifications

**About Varmoda**

Varmoda is a federal IT solutions provider founded in 2020 and headquartered in McLean, Virginia, delivering citizen-centric public services across Financial Assistance, Public Benefits, and Security & Defense domains. Our five-layer architecture — Salesforce (Engagement), Databricks (Data), ServiceNow (Orchestration), Pega (Decisioning), and Oracle HR (Capacity) — puts data at the common thread of every solution we build for federal agencies and the citizens they serve. Varmoda holds CMMI Maturity Level 3, ISO 9001, ISO 20000, and ISO 27001 certifications, and is recognized as a V3 veteran-friendly employer.

**Why Varmoda**

* Growth opportunity within a fast-scaling federal IT firm
* Direct impact on citizen-facing federal programs
* Competitive benefits including 401k, health insurance, Paid Time Off, Life Insurance and others — customize per role/location
* Veteran-friendly (V3) workplace culture

jobs.title: Electrical Design Engineer – PCB/MCM Layout, Design (m/f/d)
jobs.description:
**Electrical Design Engineer – PCB/MCM Layout, Design (m/f/d)**

**Would you like to turn complex subsea challenges into robust, real‑time software solutions?**

**Are you looking for a place where you can grow your skills in embedded software development and beyond?**

**Partner with the best**

Baker Hughes stands as a leading global energy‑technology company, delivering innovative solutions that make energy safer, cleaner, and more efficient across the entire value chain. Operating in more than 120 countries, the company blends deep industrial expertise with advanced engineering and digital technologies to support energy production, transformation, and decarbonization. With over a century of heritage, Baker Hughes partners with customers in oil and gas, industrial sectors, and emerging energy markets to accelerate progress toward a more sustainable energy future.

**Take ownership by leading complex projects**

As an PCB/MCM designer, you will collaborate with multi-disciplinary project teams within our product development department and work closely with electrical engineers. You will be responsible for designing multilayer PCBs and MCM substrate layouts for use in downhole drilling tools under extreme environmental conditions. In this role, you will strengthen our PCB/MCM layout group for high-temperature downhole applications as well as surface equipment electronics. Your responsibilities will span the entire layout process of electronic designs, including adjustment of requirement specification, implementation, verification & validation and documentation.

**As Electrical Design Engineer – PCB/MCM Layout, Design you will be responsible for:**

* Taking ownership of MCM substrate and PCB design with Siemens Xpedition and Altium Designer
* Creating of ECAD library symbols and footprints
* Working in the PCB/MCM group that designs PCB and MCM substrates for multiple project teams
* Creation of the required manufacturing data and documentation

**To be successful in this role you will:**

  

* 3+ years of experience at MCM substrate and PCB design, preferably with Siemens Xpedition
* Good knowledge of the manufacturing processes of PC boards and assemblies
* Decent experience at modifying electrical schematics and layouts with Siemens Xpedition
* Good understanding of electrical circuitry and applicable MCM substrate and PCB requirements
* Experience and knowledge of the functionality of ECAD Libraries
* Good skills at creating technical drawings and documentation
* Self-contained, self-motivated and structured to work within a worldwide functioning interdisciplinary team
* Have good written and verbal English skills, due to working in an international diverse working environment

**Work in a way that works for you**

We recognize that everyone is different and that the way in which people want to work and deliver at their best is different for everyone too. In this role, we can offer the following flexible working patterns:

* Working remotely from home or any other work location
* Working flexible hours - choose the times when you work in the day to help you fit in everything in and work when you are most productive

**Working for you**

Our inventions have revolutionized energy for over a century. But to keep going forward tomorrow, we know we must push the boundaries today. We prioritize rewarding those who embrace change with a package that reflects how much we value their input. Join us, and you can expect:

* Contemporary work-life balance policies and wellbeing activities
* Safety net of life insurance and disability programs
* Tailored financial programs
* Additional elected or voluntary benefits

The initial pay range for this position will be PLN 146,000 To 270,000. There are no provisions of any collective agreement relating to pay which will be applied to this position.

  
The Baker Hughes internal title for this role is: Lead Engineer, Electrical, Product Design and Engineering**About Us:**

We are an energy technology company that provides solutions to energy and industrial customers worldwide. Built on a century of experience and conducting business in over 120 countries, our innovative technologies and services are taking energy forward – making it safer, cleaner and more efficient for people and the planet.

  
**Join Us:**

Are you seeking an opportunity to make a real difference in a company that values innovation and progress? Join us and become part of a team of people who will challenge and inspire you! Let’s come together and take energy forward.  
  
Baker Hughes Company is an Equal Opportunity Employer. Employment decisions are made without regard to race, color, religion, national or ethnic origin, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, age, disability, protected veteran status or other characteristics protected by law.

jobs.title: Mid .NET Full Stack Software Engineer III
jobs.description:
C.H. Robinson is hiring a Software Engineer III (.NET Full Stack) to join our technology team in Warsaw!

As a Software Engineer III (.NET Full Stack), you’ll work closely with product managers, architects, engineers, and business stakeholders to design and develop complex solutions that deliver real value to our customers. Your expertise in .NET, databases, and distributed systems will be key as you optimize and modernize code for performance, scalability, and reliability. You’ll join a highly collaborative Book Team focused on the shipment-booking domain, including carrier offers, shipments available to book, pricing guidance, and the services that enable carrier booking. This is a full-stack role with a strong focus on backend, database, and middle-tier engineering.

At C.H. Robinson, we support a healthy work-life balance through flexible work arrangements. This role is based in Poland, with a preference for candidates in Warsaw or within reasonable commuting distance. The team may meet in the Warsaw office periodically for collaboration, while day-to-day work can be performed flexibly based on what works best for you and the team.

Join us in a fast-paced environment where you can take ownership of meaningful projects, collaborate across our global technology organization, and help modernize critical systems that support how freight is booked!

**RESPONSIBILITIES**

* Define interfaces, develop solutions, and influence architectural changes in partnership with principal engineers, product partners, and other stakeholders.
* Optimize, refactor, modernize, and reuse code for performance, scalability, and maintainability.
* Research complex problems, translate high-level requirements into technical designs, and break smaller projects into deliverable work.
* Increase code quality through code reviews, automated testing, and sound engineering practices.
* Proactively troubleshoot and resolve production issues across distributed systems.
* Implement secure programming patterns and enhance application security.
* Estimate project needs and dependencies, communicate progress, and drive work through to completion.
* Collaborate actively with engineers across Poland and the United States, sharing opinions, feedback, and technical knowledge.
* Use AI-assisted engineering tools for coding, research, and design while applying independent judgement and validating the quality of the output.

**QUALIFICATIONS**

**Required:**

* 3+ years of experience working in a software development team environment
* 3+ years of experience creating applications and features in an object-oriented environment (e.g., C#, .NET)
* Experience working with relational databases and SQL, including database objects, queries, and data-focused application development
* Experience designing or developing microservices, APIs, or distributed systems (e.g., WebAPI, ServiceStack, REST APIs)
* Experience with Kubernetes or containerized application environments
* Experience with code reviews, code optimization, unit testing, acceptance testing, and version control systems (e.g., Git, GitHub, TFS)
* Experience independently researching and designing a small project, breaking down the work, and driving it through to completion
* Strong communication and collaboration skills, including sharing opinions, giving feedback, and communicating timelines and project progress
* Experience using AI-assisted engineering tools, with the ability to critically review and validate the output
* Fluent English

**Preferred:**

* Experience with data streaming architecture and frameworks (e.g., Kafka, RabbitMQ, ESB)
* Experience with Azure DevOps pipelines
* Experience with system integration, global projects, or large-scale distributed systems
* Experience with transportation, logistics, booking, pricing, or other business-critical systems

**WHAT WE OFFER**

* A fun, open, and inclusive workplace that encourages innovative thinking
* Opportunities for professional growth with access to training platforms
* Flexible work arrangements to support a healthy work-life balance
* Full-time employment contracts (umowa o pracę - UoP)
* Comprehensive benefits: competitive salary and performance-based bonuses, private medical care, Employee Assistance Program (EAP), Employee Stock Purchase Plan (ESPP) after one year of employment

We will review applications for this role on an ongoing basis and encourage all interested candidates to apply at their earliest convenience.

**Compensation Range**

zł174,500.00 - zł373,300.00

The base pay range displayed on each job posting reflects the minimum and maximum base pay for the position across the entirety of the country this requisition is posted in. Your individual base pay within this range is determined by work location, which takes into account geographic cost of labor, and additional factors, including job-related skills, experience, and relevant education or training. Compensation details listed in this posting reflect the base pay only.

Questioning if you meet the mark? Studies have shown that some individuals may be less likely to apply unless they match the job description exactly. Here at C.H. Robinson, we’re building an inclusive workplace where all employees feel they belong. If this position excites you, we welcome you to apply whether you check all the preferred qualifications or just a few. You may just be our next great fit!

jobs.title: Mainframe software engineer (senior)
jobs.description:
Would you like to join the Collateral & Impairment team in Reporting Solutions responsible for several business-critical data hubs of collateral and credit deterioration data for business solutions and reporting processes? Do you want to participate in the data tech transformation in BEC, soon to be Nykredit Financial Technologies?

BEC is looking for a Software Engineer to join the Reporting Solutions domain. The position will be based at our friendly office in Roskilde or Warsaw.

Reporting Solutions plays a vital role in ensuring compliance of BEC’s member banks by managing a portfolio of 40+ business solutions within the business areas of Credit Risk and Finance Solutions, including several business-critical data hubs that support banks' business processes, internal reporting, and obligations in regulatory reporting.

You will join the Collateral & Impairment team with responsibility for both maintenance and development of a portfolio of business solutions that ensure accurate, reliable, and traceable data on assets, collateral, impairment, and write-off used in business-critical credit risk processes as well as regulatory reporting.

You will join a high‑performing, cross‑functional team, combining solid business knowledge with strong software engineering practices. The team works with Mainframe, Netezza, and Databricks platforms and does coding in COBOL, SQL, and Java, and apply BI tools such as PowerCenter and SAP Business Objects. The team is currently situated in Herning but will transition and consolidate in Roskilde and Warsaw by end of 2027.

This role offers a unique opportunity to work at the forefront of BEC’s data tech transformation, using modern, Cloud-based technologies and event‑driven architectures to build scalable data products to substitute for current business solutions. This will give banks easier access to trusted, consistent data, whether for self-service analytics, reporting, regulatory requirements, or operational processes.

**Primary tasks and responsibilities include:**

* Manage incidents and problems effectively in close collaboration with colleagues and clients.
* Maintain and develop systems, data, and platforms within the business area of Credit Risk.
* Ensure stable operations through maintenance, housekeeping, and quality improvements.
* Design end-to-end data processing flows for collateral, impairment, and regulatory data.
* Develop high-quality business solutions based on business requirements in close cooperation with key stakeholders internally in BEC and clients.
* Collaborate closely with Business Analysts, Software Engineers, and Architects in Reporting Solutions to ensure high-quality, reliable, and well‑governed data foundations.
* Participate in the data tech transformation in BEC towards a modern data platform using Databricks.
* Contribute to continuous improvement of the development process and client engagement.

**To succeed you will have:**

* A relevant Master degree.
* 5y+ work experience as Software Engineer from Banking or financial IT.
* Preferably, with work experience as a team architect.
* Preferably, work experience from the banking sector in Denmark.
* Extensive knowledge of collateral, impairment, and regulatory data.
* Extensive work experience with Mainframe, DB2, JCL, COBOL, and I\*Net.
* Preferably, programming skills in SQL, Python, and Java.
* Preferably, experience with PowerCenter workflow development.
* Experience with Git, Jira, and CI/CD pipelines.
* Experience of working in agile setups like Scrum or SAFe.
* Strong collaboration and communication skills.
* Fluency in English, written and spoken.
* Danish is an advantage.

As a person, you are ambitious, goal oriented, and persistent. You have a curious and analytical mindset. You are a team player who is proactive and takes responsibility. You are service minded towards both clients and colleagues.

**Be your best self with BEC's benefits!**

We offer a diverse range of benefits for our employees. Here are just a few of them.

* Professional development budget
* Healthy, varied lunch and fruit in the canteen
* Active staff associations: yoga, cycling, go-karting, salsa dancing etc.
* Flexible starting time
* Health insurance
* Referral bonus

**What does the recruitment process look like?**

* Send us your CV: We want to get to know you

* Screening call: Let's chat and see if we're a match

* Meet our technical expert: Learn more about the job, BEC Poland, and tell us more about your skills and experience.

* Meet your future manager

* Time to sign the contract: We're ready to welcome you to BEC!

If you have any questions about the position, please contact Talent attraction partner, Anna Barcińska at Anna.Barcinska@BEC.dk.
